cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: What Rule Did I Miss?
cards.instruction: Find the hidden rule that makes the strange situation consistent, practical, or at least survivable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Your shadow moved before you. What changed?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was thinking of leaving, but I can't find the exit.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Think about that bench without moving. Does it turn?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's gone to the bench. I'm still here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It seems to follow your intentions. Think about the exit again; let's follow slowly and see whether it knows the way.

mechanism: A corrects experimental movement while finding the intention rule that lets a lost person use an independent shadow as a guide.
confusable: Generic surreal acceptance lacks D150's testable consistency; S03 must actively manage how B tests it.
comparison: Navigation through intention differs from controlling soup direction at a sink.
seedUse: Keep thought test, bench result and exit application; make corrections specific to B's proposed bodily movement.
